svg.title: Researcher Banner — CS · AI · Mathematics · Physics
svg.desc: A Feynman quote beside a schematic of coherent wave packets approaching an interaction region, interfering and scattering into outgoing channels. Equations describe Schrödinger evolution, probability density, normalization, unitary scattering and gradient descent. This is an illustrative animation, not a numerical simulation. Adapts to light, dark and reduced-motion preferences.
